    "An isolated purchase is generalized into ongoing demand for related equipment, specialized supplies, or bulk quantities."
  ],
  "UNDERUSED_OR_MISSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Repeated, recent, coherent interactions provide stronger evidence of current intent than isolated historical purchases.",
    "Compatibility, suitable quantities, existing ownership, and added usefulness determine whether related products become worthwhile choices.",
    "Specific artists, musical relationships, tone, and combinations of preferences distinguish immediate choices from broad taste alignment."
  ],
  "PRIMARY_FAILURE_MODE_AT_TOP_OF_LIST": "Broad association appears to outweigh a concrete current-use connection, leaving too many leading recommendations related to users' histories but insufficiently compelling to choose now.",

    "The proportion of leading recommendations users identify as immediate choices, distinguished from merely related or potentially useful items.",
    "The frequency of rejection for redundant ownership, incompatible specifications, excessive quantity, or an unsupported task or hobby.",
    "The relative ranking of items supported by repeated recent interests versus items supported only by broad associations or isolated older interactions.",
    "The frequency of unassessable recommendations, tracked separately from explicit preference mismatches so missing item information is not mistaken for dislike."
  ]
}
